Auto2000 geographic evidence explorer

Four bounded study windows. Explore public provider records and modelled travel from sampled grid origins. This file works offline and uses no external map tiles.

Inspect a record

Click a provider or origin to inspect its evidence and modelled access. Drag to pan; use the mouse wheel to zoom.

The dashed outline is the origin-study rectangle. It is not an administrative boundary. Longitude and latitude use WGS84.

How to interpret this map: Grid points are computational origins, not customer homes. The default ≤250 m snapping screen can remove paired results; grey squares indicate missing access values, not zero travel time. Mapped repair/service records do not establish equivalent Toyota/job capability. OSRM duration is a model output, not measured traffic or appointment availability. Positive additional minutes mean Auto2000 is slower to reach than the nearest listed mapped candidate; this does not predict switching or gross profit. Provider retrieval extends beyond the origin rectangle, but inventories remain finite and incomplete.

Sources: Official Auto2000, OtoXpert and Shop & Drive directories retrieved 14 November 2026; Overture Maps Places release 2026-10-21.0; OSRM driving responses and source snapshots in the accompanying ZIP. Original attribution and licensing records are retained there. This analytical explorer contains no road basemap.
